correctness.rationale: PASS: For 0<t<1 and 0<theta<pi, forward angle g_t=atan2(sin theta, cos theta+t) is strictly increasing and smaller than theta. Solving sin(theta−g)=t sin(g) gives inverse Q_t(theta)=theta+asin(t sin(theta)), so time-n cap nonentrance is initial polar angles above Q_t^n(epsilon); its exact surface-area integral follows from sin^(d−1) angular density. With δ=1−t, r_j=π−Q_t^j(epsilon) obeys r_{j+1}=r_j−asin((1−δ)sin r_j). Nonresonance α∈(π/2,π) yields r_m~−tan(α)δ; at dyadic resonance α=π/2 yields sqrt(2δ), and εδ=π/2^m+z sqrtδ/2^(m−1) yields r_m/sqrtδ→sqrt(z²+2)−z. Each further fixed step multiplies by δ; cap volume is A_d r^d. Correct integer m=ceil(log2(π/epsilon)) and fixed d≥2,n≥m quantifiers and limiting antipode excluded. Independent high-precision constants corroborated.
